fields.description: The LionsBot R5 is an autonomous commercial floor scrubber that cleans up to 5,000 m2 per charge on a 520 mm cleaning path. It turns 360 degrees in place, so it handles dead ends and tight corners without reversing. LionsBot publishes a 200 kg mass, 690 x 690 x 1,125 mm dimensions, 50 L solution and 40 L recovery tanks, up to 34 g/cm2 brush pressure, 1.1 m/s maximum cleaning speed, 1,300 m2/h average and 2,059 m2/h maximum efficiency, 4 h 20 min maximum run time and 3 h 30 min charging. It uses a 3D LiDAR, two depth cameras, three RGB cameras, two 2D LiDARs, four sonars and two time-of-flight sensors, plus a Gap-Free Tri-Brush system, H13 HEPA filter, MagicTag zone setup and an included charging and refuel station. No numeric price or IP rating is published.

companyFocus.name: LionsBot
companyFocus.reviewNotes: Batch161. LionsBot pages read as text only; no research browser, visual inspection, OCR or media reuse. R5, R3 Scrub Pro and R3 Vac are three current machines; R12 Rex CS is a separate 2023 sweeper-scrubber. No login, forms, contact, messages or transactions. All USPs, complete portfolios and leadership remain unproven.
highlights: LionsBot is a Singapore cleaning-robot manufacturer whose current range is the R5, R3 Scrub Pro and R3 Vac.
The company says it has more than 7,000 robots deployed in more than 40 countries and eight years of cleaning-robot development.
Its machines scrub, vacuum and navigate autonomously in airports, hospitals, malls, warehouses and logistics centres.
LionsCloud fleet software records schedules, coverage and completion for every run, and LionsBot sells through certified dealers.
LionsBot lists IEC 63327 product certification and ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 27001, SOC 2, SOC 3 and GDPR compliance.

body-scope-check.versionScopes: R5, R3 Scrub Pro and R3 Vac are three current machines, not tiers or cut-down versions of one another. R12 Rex CS is a separate 2023 sweeper-scrubber. The catalog rows are distinct models.
body-scope-check.priceScopes: The reviewed LionsBot pages publish no numeric purchase price or rental rate. Catalog values of about 75,750 USD for the R3 Scrub Pro and about 140 USD per month for the R3 Vac and R12 are not supported by the reviewed pages and are cleared.
body-scope-check.weightScopes: R5 publishes 200 kg, R3 Scrub Pro 85.5 kg and R3 Vac 53 kg. No R12 mass is published.
body-scope-check.sizeScopes: R5 publishes 690 x 690 x 1,125 mm, R3 Scrub Pro 635 x 570 x 828 mm and R3 Vac 521 x 482 x 655 mm. No R12 dimensions are published.
body-scope-check.payloadScopes: No reviewed LionsBot page publishes a payload rating; tank capacities and brush pressure are not payload.
body-scope-check.enduranceScopes: R5 publishes 4 h 20 min run time and 3 h 30 min charging. R3 Scrub Pro publishes up to 3 h and 2 h charging. R3 Vac publishes up to 3 h, 2 h charging and 1,400 m2 per charge. R12 publishes no run time; its 100,000 sq ft is coverage per charge, not an area rate.
body-scope-check.autonomyScopes: LionsBot describes AI SmartClean path planning, obstacle adaptation and self-recovery with MagicTag zone setup. These are manufacturer descriptions, not independent safety certification or proof of unsupervised operation.
body-scope-check.listingScopes: The roboticsdir and buyandrentrobots listings name products and companies; they do not establish prices, current stock, delivered fleets or independent performance.
